en.title: Buying a Tavelo frame: official routes, dealer stock and model generations
en.description: How to buy a Tavelo Arden frameset: check the official route, current model generation, frame-size labels, cockpit package and dealer responsibilities.
en.intro: A current Arden listing, an older Attack owner post and a dealer’s stock page can look like one buying story. They are different frames and transactions. Start with the exact Arden version and ask which parts your seller includes.

sections.heading: Start at tavelo.cc and its dealer locator
paragraphs: Use the [Tavelo brand site](https://www.tavelo.cc/) and [retailer page](https://tavelo.cc/pages/dealer), then ask the seller for the exact Arden version, size, finish and cockpit. The current Arden product selector and an older geometry chart use different size-label sets in our evidence. Do not translate a label from one into the other by guesswork; ask for the chart corresponding to the frame actually offered.

The [Arden record](/models/tavelo-arden/#source-records) identifies the pictured frame and the documented 1× versus 2× tire-clearance distinction. A promotional complete-bike image does not specify which bars or headset parts come with your frameset.

sections.heading: An old Attack purchase is a lead, not a current stock check
paragraphs: A [2024 Attack owner discussion](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4757.0) mentioned a purchase route via Panda Podium despite a web listing that looked unavailable. It is an old lead, not today’s stock report and not an Arden review. Verify the current seller relationship through Tavelo before using it.

The value in the old thread is the question it raises: when a product page says “sold out,” can an authorized seller obtain your exact version, and from which stock pool? Ask that question directly; do not borrow the Attack owner’s fit or delivery result.

sections.heading: Price the cockpit and its future adjustments
paragraphs: Ask Tavelo or the seller for the assembly manual and geometry chart for the exact Arden you will receive. The current listing establishes a frame, fork, seatpost, headset bearing and axles as frameset components; cockpit configuration varies. Ask for every cover, spacer, mount and fastener that belongs to the proposed cockpit.
Show those choices to the fitter or assembler before ordering. A later change in bar width can be a parts and labor decision, not a five-minute swap. Price the full approved front end in each quote.

sections.heading: Keep the handover responsibilities clear
paragraphs: Record who sells the frame, who dispatches it, and who handles a defect claim. Ask for the delivered total, import-charge treatment, expected dispatch and the conditions for changing or cancelling the order.

Before assembly, photograph the supplied parts and preserve labels and packaging. Ask the seller to resolve any mismatch against the agreed specification before the build turns it into a harder-to-document problem.
A good Tavelo purchase is a complete agreement about one exact frame. The owner threads are useful companions, but the invoice and the current seller’s answers should be doing the heavy lifting.

zh-Hans.title: Tavelo 车架购买指南：官方渠道、经销库存与车型代际
zh-Hans.description: Tavelo Arden 车架如何购买：核对官方渠道、准确代际、尺码标记、把组套餐与经销责任。
zh-Hans.intro: 当前 Arden 商品、老 Attack 车主帖和经销商库存页很容易被看成同一笔购买经历，其实车型和交易都不同。先锁定准确 Arden 版本，再核对卖家提供的部件。

sections.heading: 从 tavelo.cc 和经销商查询开始
paragraphs: 从 [Tavelo 官网](https://www.tavelo.cc/)和[经销页面](https://tavelo.cc/pages/dealer)开始，向卖家问准 Arden 版本、尺码、颜色与把组。现有证据中，当前 Arden 商品选择器与较早几何表采用不同的尺码标签组合。别猜一个标签在另一份表里对应什么；应索取实际所售车架的几何表。
[Arden 记录](/models/tavelo-arden/#source-records)说明图中车型，以及单盘和双盘不同的轮胎空间。宣传整车照片不能定义你这套车架包含哪支车把或哪些碗组零件。

sections.heading: 旧 Attack 购买经历不是当前库存证明
paragraphs: [2024 年 Attack 车主讨论](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4757.0)提到网页似乎缺货时仍可联系 Panda Podium。这是老渠道线索，不是今天的库存报告，更不是 Arden 评测。使用之前先通过 Tavelo 核对当前卖家关系。
老帖有用的地方，是提醒人问：商品页显示“售罄”时，授权卖家能否取得准确版本？从哪个库存池调货？直接问清即可，别借用 Attack 车主的合身或交付结果。

sections.heading: 把把组及日后调整算进去
paragraphs: 向 Tavelo 或卖家索取实际交付 Arden 的装配手册和几何表。当前商品记录将车架、前叉、座管、碗组轴承和桶轴列为车架套装部件，把组配置则可能不同。请卖家逐一列出对应上盖、垫圈、支架及紧固件。
下单前让合身顾问或装配者看这些选择。日后更改把宽可能涉及部件和工时，并非拧松几颗螺丝就能完成。每份报价都应算入完整认可前端。

sections.heading: 把交付责任讲清楚
paragraphs: 记录销售方、发货方及缺陷索赔责任方。问到手总额、进口费用处理、预计发货，以及修改或取消订单的条件。
装车前拍下内含部件并保留标签和包装。若与约定不符，先让卖家处理，别装好后才变成更难说明的问题。
好的 Tavelo 交易，应是围绕一款准确车架形成的完整约定。车主帖可以辅助，但最终要依靠发票与当前卖家的明确答复。
